mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dieta (nombre_dieta, total_calorias, observaciones, id_medico) VALUES (#{nombreDieta}, 0.00, #{observaciones}, #{idMedico})
mapper.select: SELECT id_dieta AS idDieta, nombre_dieta AS nombreDieta, total_calorias AS totalCalorias, observaciones, id_medico AS idMedico, editable FROM vw_dieta_pacientes_count ORDER BY nombre_dieta
SELECT id_dieta AS idDieta, nombre_dieta AS nombreDieta, total_calorias AS totalCalorias, observaciones, id_medico AS idMedico, editable FROM vw_dieta_pacientes_count WHERE id_dieta = #{idDieta}
